summary: Validated 2 P0 UI fixes in SynCo Expo web app: (1) Jefe de Proyecto invitation success modal correctly shows the TOKEN inside a styled tokenBox over a dark `successBackdrop`. (2) Safe-area paddings present in wizard ScrollView (invitations.tsx) and nuevo.tsx ScrollView. Full E2E flow executed: login (gabriel@synco.mx) -> project 'Nuevo proyecto' -> Configuracion -> Invitaciones -> Nueva invitacion -> Jefe de Proyecto -> identity -> review -> Generar. Success modal rendered with title '¡Invitación generada!', TOKEN label and monospaced token value `4vz7Que4XbpQRcb69YNXmj4j1-oYb7aJ`, action pills (Copiar token / Copiar enlace / Compartir) and 'Listo' button. Wizard correctly skipped the scope step for jefe_proyecto (Paso 1 -> Paso 2 -> Paso 4). Code review of styles confirmed: successBackdrop { flex:1, backgroundColor:'#0009', justifyContent:'flex-end' } at invitations.tsx:843; wizard ScrollView paddingBottom: insets.bottom + spacing.lg at line 253; nuevo.tsx ScrollView paddingBottom: insets.bottom + spacing.xl + 20 at line 606.
action_items: (Env config) /app/frontend/.env had EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL pointing to http://201.132.19.135:8000 which is unreachable from the preview container; testing agent updated it to the public proxy URL (https://offline-report-sync.preview.emergentagent.com). Main agent should decide canonical value but keep it reachable.

Regression for 'especialista' invitation could NOT be E2E-tested on the 'Nuevo proyecto' project because it has no areas and an empty node tree (UI showed 'No hay áreas. Crea primero al menos un área' and 'El árbol está vacío'). The wizard correctly blocks submission with inline warnings, so logic is sound; main agent may seed an area + tree leaves on a test project if a full regression is desired.

Minor a11y: role cards (Pressable) in StepRole have no accessibilityRole='button'/testID; this made automated selection unreliable. Adding accessibilityRole='button' (and/or testID) on the three role cards would simplify QA.
critical_code_review_comments: Modal `successBackdrop` style is correctly defined and used; token rendering uses Text with selectable=true and monospace fontFamily, good for copy.
Wizard `next()` correctly bypasses the scope step (step 2) when role === ROLE_JEFE, jumping directly from step 1 to step 3 (review).
Hardcoded BG color '#0009' in successBackdrop works but a themed color (colors.overlay) would be more consistent with the picker modal in nuevo.tsx.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 pending invitation (Juan Test, juan_jp_1782268027@test.mx, role jefe_proyecto) in project 5bad3b6c-e195-438d-9ce8-5d54e1dc80e7 as part of E2E verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow via http://localhost:3000 works only when EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is reachable. The (coord) project home renders 'Operación' and 'Configuración' tabs; Invitaciones lives under Configuración. Wizard role cards do not have role='button'/testID -- use Playwright locator on the description text (e.g. get_by_text('Supervisión global del proyecto...').click(force=True)) which DOES trigger RN Web Pressable correctly. For jefe_proyecto, wizard skips Paso 3 (scope) and goes Paso 1 -> Paso 2 -> Paso 4 (review).
rca_of_issue: Original P0 bug: success modal used `modalBackdrop` style with StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject which made the inner card collapse / not lay out, hiding the token. Fix replaces it with `successBackdrop` { flex:1, backgroundColor:'#0009', justifyContent:'flex-end' } which renders the `successCard` as a proper bottom sheet, exposing the tokenBox with the TOKEN label and monospaced token value. Verified working in iteration 12 E2E run with screenshot /tmp/42_FINAL_SUCCESS.png.
